text:
Conflict card for developer:

Input at intake is turbidity 10 and maintenance_lock true.

Rule A - Filter water at turbidity ten or higher - applies and asks for action filter.

Rule B - A maintenance lock requires shutdown - applies and asks for action shutdown.

Both rules apply to the same input but ask for incompatible actions: filter vs shutdown.

Which rule wins?
cost_basis: all terminal provider usage, persisted from first request
